description: This file defines the interface for interprocess communication (IPC) related to the file system monitor daemon in a Git-related project. It declares functions to check support, retrieve IPC paths, query daemon status, and send commands or queries to the daemon.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the built-in file system monitor daemon is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Returns the pathname to the IPC communication endpoint (named pipe or Unix domain socket) for the daemon, specific to a repository.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Determines whether the `git-fsmonitor--daemon` process is active and listening.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Connects to the daemon and requests the list of changed files since a given token, possibly spawning the daemon if needed.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command verb to the daemon without attempting to start it if absent.

calls: simple-ipc.h functions (not specified individually, but used via wrapper functions)
